lede: Shan · อักษรไทใหญ่ accounts for 176 catalogued manuscripts, 2 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Mae Hong Son (82% of the corpus for this script), ahead of Chiang Mai and Phayao. By support it leans to mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (95%) over khoi paper · กระดาษข่อย (4%). Dated witnesses run 1880–2001 CE (103 of 176 carry a date).

findings.title: The minority hands: scripts beyond Tham Lanna
findings.gloss: Almost the whole collection is written in Tham Lanna.

findings.title: Where three tongues share a page
findings.gloss: Manuscripts whose language is named as three or more tongues at once — Pali scripture threaded through Shan, Burmese, or Lao.
